classification_definition.DROPPED: unsupported lexical concept present in source is absent from the CIR and no associated source numeric literal is mapped into a supported numeric CIR field
classification_definition.MAPPED_TO_SUPPORTED_FIELD: source numeric literal associated with unsupported requirement appears in a supported numeric CIR field while unsupported lexical concept is not preserved as free text
classification_definition.OTHER_AMBIGUOUS: case does not satisfy the deterministic rules above
classification_definition.PRESERVED_AS_TEXT: unsupported lexical concept survives in CIR objective/coverage

interpretation_boundary: This deterministic lexical/numeric forensic classifier is specific to the frozen synthetic unsupported-parameter cases and is not claimed to be a general semantic-equivalence detector.
